The product must be \(1000a+638\). Since it equals \(7N\), we need
\[
1000a+638 \equiv 0 \pmod 7.
\]
Now \(1000\equiv 6\pmod 7\) and \(638\equiv 1\pmod 7\), so
\[
6a+1\equiv 0 \pmod 7 \implies 6a\equiv 6 \pmod 7 \implies a\equiv 1 \pmod 7.
\]
Since \(7N\le 6993\), the only possible thousands digit is \(a=1\). Thus
\[
7N=1638 \implies N=234.
\]

\boxed{234}
